verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line noting the CLI can be run 'from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron,' implying users could wire up their own cron-based scheduling — but Foreloop itself documents no native recurring-job/workflow scheduler, retry policy, or schedule management UI. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduling feature, documented recurring-workflow configuration, and evidence of built-in cron/interval management within the product.
